title: Ladder: motor start delay with a TON box
summary: The request and the warning lamp are already drawn. Add a rung with a TON on-delay box so the conveyor motor starts 3 seconds after the request, and watch the box count its elapsed time online.
objectives: Place a TON box in a rung and set its instance name and preset time
Use the power leaving the box (its Q output) to drive a coil
Observe the elapsed time ET counting in the running PLC
instructions: Rung 1 latches Request with Start; Stop (StopPB FALSE) or an overload clears it. Rung 2 lights RunLamp as a warning.
Add a rung: a normally open contact on Request, then a TON box with the preset PT T#3s, then the MotorContactor coil.
Power leaves the TON box only when its time has elapsed (Q), so the motor starts 3 s after the request and stops at once when the request drops.
Write the elapsed time to a TIME variable through the box's ET output if you want to see it in the variable list; the box itself shows ET online.
hints: Select the Request contact of the new rung, keep Insert position After and insert TON on-delay timer.
The preset is a TIME literal such as T#3s; a plain number is rejected by the compiler.
A TOF or TP box would switch the motor on immediately: only TON delays switching on.

criteria.title: The warning lamp lights at once
criteria.onFail: RunLamp did not light when Start was pressed.

criteria.title: The motor does not start before the delay
criteria.onFail: The motor started before 3 s had elapsed.

criteria.title: The motor starts after 3 s
criteria.onFail: The motor was not running 3.7 s after Start.

criteria.title: Stop cancels the start
criteria.onFail: The motor started although Stop was pressed during the warning.
